## Key Takeaways


- Sacramento International Airport (SMF) celebrates the grand opening of the new Terminal B Parking Garage, a key part of the SMForward program.
- The six-level garage adds over 5,500 parking spaces, enhancing convenience for travelers and accommodating regional growth.
- The Parsons-Vanir Joint Venture manages construction and oversight, including additional facilities and improvements under the SMForward program.
- Officials emphasize collaboration among stakeholders to ensure safety and functionality during the airport enhancements.
- The new garage marks a significant milestone, reinforcing SMF’s commitment to improving passenger experiences and regional transportation needs.


**Sacramento International Airport (SMF) is celebrating the grand opening of its new Terminal B Parking Garage, a visible step forward for SMForward, the Sacramento County Department of Airports’ multiyear program to modernize the airport, improve the passenger experience, and prepare for continued regional growth.**


Located west of Terminal B, the six-level garage adds more than 5,500 parking spaces, significantly expanding close-in parking for travelers and offering greater convenience from the moment they arrive at the airport.


For the Parsons-Vanir SMF Joint Venture (PVJV), the milestone also reflects the coordination required to deliver major infrastructure improvements within an active airport environment.[Selected by the Sacramento Department of Airports in 2024](https://www.parsons.com/2024/07/parsons-vanir-jv-awarded-sacramento-international-airports-cmi-contract/) , the PVJV provides construction management, and inspection services for SMForward. In addition to the garage, the program includes a consolidated rental car facility, additional gates at Terminals A and B, roadway improvements, and a passenger skywalk to Concourse B.


Delivering this interconnected program within an active airport requires working across all stakeholders, including the Department of Airports, contractors, project partners, and the local workforce. PVJV is advancing improvements while maintaining safe, reliable operations for passengers, airlines, and employees.


“The opening of Terminal B Parking Garage 2 represents a significant milestone in our SMForward program and our commitment to making travel through Sacramento International Airport more convenient and accessible,” said Cindy Nichol, Director of Airports for Sacramento County. “As our region continues to grow, we’re investing in the infrastructure needed to meet increasing demand while improving the passenger experience. Projects of this scale require tremendous coordination, and we’re grateful to our partners at Parsons-Vanir for helping bring this vision to life.”


“Parsons is proud to partner with Vanir and the Sacramento County Department of Airports as SMForward moves from planning into visible improvements for Sacramento travelers,” said Chris Rogers, said Chris Rogers, senior vice president, Aviation for Parsons. “The Terminal B Parking Garage opening demonstrates what strong collaboration across the entire project team can accomplish while keeping the airport operating and focused on the passenger experience.”


“We value our partnership with Parsons, a true collaboration that connects people to their destinations safely,” said Dorene Dominguez, Vanir Chairwoman and CEO. “Vanir is honored to be part of the Parsons-Vanir Joint Venture, supporting the Sacramento County Department of Airports and its SMForward program as it modernizes Sacramento International Airport. As a Sacramento-headquartered company, we take great pride in contributing to this vital expansion and our region’s future.”


The garage is one milestone in a much larger transformation at SMF. As SMForward advances, the program will continue to reshape how passengers arrive at and move through the airport while building the capacity and flexibility to meet the region’s future transportation needs.


For Parsons and Vanir, the work reflects a shared commitment to delivering complex infrastructure programs that strengthen communities and keep people moving.
